titles.native: 劇場短編マクロスF ～時の迷宮～

description:
Ranka Lee is on an interplanetary concert tour several years after the battle against the Vajra. While on tour, she visits the ruins of a temple known as the Well of Souls, a place used to communicate with the gods and the dead. Ranka approaches the ruins and finds herself pulled deep within.

(Source: Disney+)
